sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ycells(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']==4:
            r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(r),min(c)))
    return sorted(out)
plan = [
 ('RCW',(17,39),[(17,32),(38,23)]),
 ('RCW',(17,39),[(17,35),(35,23)]),
 ('L35R',(35,48),[(17,35),(35,26)]),
 ('RCW',(17,39),[(20,35),(35,26)]),
 ('RCW',(17,39),[(23,35),(35,26)]),
 ('RCW',(17,39),[(26,35),(35,26)]),
 ('L35R',(35,48),[(26,35),(35,29)]),
 ('L35R',(35,48),[(26,35),(35,32)]),
 ('L35R',(35,48),[(26,35),(35,35)]),
]
print('start Ys:', ycells(current_frame))
for i,(name,mouse,exp) in enumerate(plan):
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':mouse[0],'col':mouse[1]}])
    got = ycells(current_frame)
    ok = got==sorted(exp)
    print(i, name, 'got', got, 'ok' if ok else 'MISMATCH exp', sorted(exp))
    if not ok or res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over'):
        break
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
